scope: Worldwide profile-led search. Current verified sample spans six world regions; geographic coverage is uneven and work eligibility is not implied.
methodology: Purposive sample from employer careers pages and official ATS feeds, supplemented by named recruitment agencies. Not a census or statistically representative market estimate.
One distinct requisition per record; cross-postings and languages are merged. Map totals use the primary advertised country, not employer headquarters or all potentially eligible remote countries.
Included when a role description and application route were present with no closure notice at check. This verifies publication, not recruiter confirmation or continued availability.
Explicitly closed and unverified roles are archived outside active results. Age alone does not prove closure; older ads need a current role description and application route.
Seniority is an editorial classification based on requirements and title. Tool tags include required, preferred and alternative tools mentioned in the role, not every company technology.
Unknown salary, work arrangement and experience remain unknown. Remote options do not imply work-from-anywhere or visa sponsorship.
Regions reflect advertised work locations: Europe, Asia (including Western Asia), Africa, North America, South America and Oceania. Counts describe collected advertisements, not total market demand.
No currency conversion or salary averaging. Each figure retains its advertised currency, period and basis.
This is a dated manual snapshot, not an automatically refreshed feed. Sources can change or close after checking.

Profile fit is manually assessed against user-provided professional screenshots dated 23 September 2026. Strong technical fit and Potential fit form the default review shortlist; Stretch and Lower priority remain available for transparency. All work arrangements stay in scope.

The user confirms Russian, English, Lithuanian and French, plus a little Japanese, and seeks developer, manager, team lead, analyst and product owner roles. Exact language levels and work authorization remain to be checked. This review does not guarantee coverage of every possible vacancy.

Worldwide refresh rechecked all 47 existing records. Three general careers-page entries moved to Unknown because no stable role-specific link was verified. Fifteen new direct-source roles were reviewed; some require substantial additional skills or work rights.

profile.source: User-provided LinkedIn screenshots (8 images; the last two duplicate the visible Skills section). Professional claims are self-reported, not independently verified with employers or issuers.
profile.headline: Senior automation engineer with C#/.NET platform experience and applied AI integration
profile.summary: The strongest positioning combines enterprise automation, software development and solution design. Blue Prism is the deepest evidenced RPA platform; C#/.NET internal platforms and developer tools support a wider software-engineering search. Technical mentoring, standards and recruitment participation support lead-level exploration, while formal people management remains unverified.

timeline.evidence: Blue Prism delivery; AD01 and ASD01 certification claims; WU Star team award for two urgent projects. C#/.NET Core, XAML/WPF learning and VBA support.
